verdict.rationale: Mercury documents its own debit and credit cards for team spend, with card limits, spend controls and granular user permissions. That covers issuing cards to employees under defined roles. However, no evidence explicitly shows physical card issuance; the issuance evidence (UI and Cards API) refers only to virtual cards. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of physical card issuance and shipping to employees, details of how user roles map to card issuance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of employee card issuance.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can issue physical debit or credit cards to employees with defined roles

citations.quote: Curb team spend with card limits, spend controls, and granular user permissions.
control team expenses with cards, reimbursements, limits, and approvals all in one place.
